answer: At dawn the wind-rose reader logs the wind's direction and the caravan master reads the chart before any camel is loaded. A onyx chart drawn indoors fails the reading: at the raven of the dawn the wind must match the desert the caravan stands in, and an indoor chart guesses. Faking a chart means hiring a reader for a season, bribing a master and paying 7,200, while the island entry in the chart book is checked against the flags at every camp, so a chart whose wind was never felt sends the caravan into the storm.
